name: translation-toolkit
description: Agent-facing contract for the translation toolkit. Human docs live in docs/; this file is the machine-readable index.

status.purpose: One-call project status: units, terms, TODOs, check and global summaries, blocking items.

options.--summary: omit units and chapter file lists
options.--deep: include full check issues and per-unit global details

check.purpose: Project-level QA: terminology, punctuation, footnote/figure counts, untranslated runs.

chunk.purpose: Split one unit into lossless, paragraph-aligned chunks for bounded context.

audit.purpose: Reproducible random sampling QA: paragraph pairs, stratified rounds, Wilson interval, stop recommendation.

options.verify: check _pairs.md against current chapters; refresh near matches, mark stale
options.recheck: list segments whose target was refreshed from current chapters

sample_size.purpose: Compute required sample size / rounds for a target residual error upper bound.

options.--reviewed N --observed K: current upper bound and remaining samples

sample_size.note: Returns an upper bound on residual error rate, not proof of zero defects.

qa.purpose: Unified QA entry: full semantic review plan, sampled review plan, or structural checks only.

options.--mode full: generate review tasks for every segment
options.--mode sample: compute sample size and create rounds

export.purpose: Export the LaTeX book to Markdown, HTML, EPUB and DOCX via Pandoc.
export.note: PDF remains the XeLaTeX build; other formats simplify layout.

global_check.purpose: Whole-book structural comparison between source/*.md and chapters/*.tex.

extract.purpose: Unified source extraction for EPUB, PDF, TXT, Markdown, HTML, DOCX, ODT, RTF, FB2, MOBI/AZW3.

engines.auto: MarkItDown for PDF/HTML when available; native for EPUB/DOCX/ODT/RTF/FB2

style.purpose: 思维阁: list, inspect or apply a translator style profile.

build.purpose: Generate, compile with XeLaTeX, copy PDF, run check; stdout is one JSON line.

exit_codes.1: blocking issue, invalid arguments, or unreadable project

conventions.json_mode: With --json, stdout contains only one JSON document; logs go to stderr or are suppressed.
conventions.project_root: A directory containing project.json and main.tex.
conventions.units: One chapter file in chapters/ plus its source/<stem>.md counterpart.
conventions.terms_authority: glossary/terms.csv is the only authority for terminology.

guardrails: Never commit copyrighted source text, translations or ebook files.
New terms must be added to glossary/terms.csv before use.
Preserve all source footnotes; use \zhu{} for translator notes.
Mark uncertainty with \todo{reason}; clear before final check.
